# Test fixtures

- `wire_states_request.bin` / `wire_states_legal_hashes.bin` — cross-language
  golden fixture for the MSG_FORWARD_STATES (A3) wire: request frame + client
  legal-order FNV-1a hashes, generated by the Rust encoder test
  `wire_states_golden_fixture` (hexo-rs/hexo-mcts/src/inference_subprocess.rs)
  and parsed by `test_wire_states_fixture.py`. Regenerate from the repo root:
  `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=hexo-rs/target-a3 HEXO_REGEN_WIRE_FIXTURES=1 cargo test -p hexo-mcts --manifest-path hexo-rs/Cargo.toml wire_states_golden_fixture`
